claims.quote: I was on the Qitaf, tied to Port Aden's eastern quay.
Rasim, who never quite believed the sea would swallow him, was on the helm like a prayer, hands grafted to the tiller.
Yusuf moved through the deck with the slow certainty of an old watch spring—checking lines, looking at faces.

claims.value: recovered from a wreck near Isle Jarrah
claims.quote: He said, simply, that they had been pulled from a wreck near Isle Jarrah, that they told of a loom at the island's heart and a thing that turns threads into fate.

He closed the amulet at my throat.

claims.value: enforces compliance and causes pain when resisting
claims.quote: When I tried to wrench it free, a hot spike flared under my ribs and something deep and old drew a line through my head. The pain was a command in another language.

claims.value: steal the spindle from Isle Jarrah
